design: SVD adjective and negation main-factor vectors at normalized adjective MLP3 input from original four quartets only. Freeze rank1 and rank4 spans. Project new quartet factor vectors, compute exact MLP bilinear cross term from projections, subtract a*n predicted term and measure fidelity to teacher local-term removal.
comparators: Adjective-only and negation-only rank4 restrictions; output rank1/rank4 projection of teacher local term using discovery output spans; three seeded random rank4 input-span pairs; identity. No norm rescaling.
limitations: New factors still require four teacher states. This is span adequacy and operator compression, not state-based encoder generalization. Output-only controls use teacher output coefficients and do not predict computation. Random spans are dimension matched but not data covariance matched.
selection: No site or rank tuning on evaluation results. Rank4 is maximum discovery span, rank1 first principal direction; rows not normalized before SVD. All cohorts evaluated, native competence gates inherited.
